// Command capture records a paired Binance depth capture: the websocket
// delta stream and a REST snapshot taken while that stream is buffering.
//
// The order matters and is the documented resync procedure: the websocket is
// connected and buffering BEFORE the snapshot is fetched, so that no delta
// falls into the gap between the two. A snapshot fetched first would leave a
// hole no capture can show.
//
// This is a throwaway used to produce test fixtures from real wire bytes. The
// real recorder is M3.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"github.com/gorilla/websocket"
)

func main() {
	symbol := flag.String("symbol", "BTCUSDT", "raw Binance symbol")
	limit := flag.Int("limit", 20, "REST depth limit")
	seconds := flag.Int("seconds", 10, "how long to buffer the delta stream")
	delay := flag.Int("snapshot-after", 3, "seconds to buffer before fetching the snapshot")
	outDir := flag.String("out", ".", "directory to write captures into")
	flag.Parse()

	stream := fmt.Sprintf("wss://stream.binance.com:9443/ws/%s@depth@100ms", strings.ToLower(*symbol))
	conn, _, err := websocket.DefaultDialer.Dial(stream, nil)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("dial %s: %v", stream, err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	log.Printf("connected to %s", stream)

	type frame struct {
		Recv time.Time
		Data []byte
	}
	var (
		mu     sync.Mutex
		frames []frame
	)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	go func() {
		defer close(done)
		for {
			_, data, err := conn.ReadMessage()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			mu.Lock()
			frames = append(frames, frame{Recv: time.Now().UTC(), Data: data})
			mu.Unlock()
		}
	}()

	// Buffer first, then snapshot. This is the ordering the resync depends on.
	time.Sleep(time.Duration(*delay) * time.Second)
	url := fmt.Sprintf("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/depth?symbol=%s&limit=%d", *symbol, *limit)
	resp, err := http.Get(url)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("fetch depth: %v", err)
	}
	snapBody, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	resp.Body.Close()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("read depth: %v", err)
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		log.Fatalf("depth: HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, snapBody)
	}
	log.Printf("snapshot fetched (%d bytes) after %ds of buffering", len(snapBody), *delay)

	time.Sleep(time.Duration(*seconds-*delay) * time.Second)
	conn.Close()
	<-done

	mu.Lock()
	defer mu.Unlock()
	log.Printf("captured %d delta frames", len(frames))

	snapPath := filepath.Join(*outDir, "depth_snapshot.raw.json")
	if err := os.WriteFile(snapPath, snapBody, 0o644); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}

	// Frames are written one raw payload per line, exactly as received.
	framePath := filepath.Join(*outDir, "depth_frames.ndjson")
	f, err := os.Create(framePath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, fr := range frames {
		f.Write(fr.Data)
		f.Write([]byte("\n"))
	}
	f.Close()

	// The point of the capture: show how the snapshot id sits against the
	// delta ids, so the M2.3 classification boundary rests on observed bytes.
	var snap struct {
		LastUpdateID int64 `json:"lastUpdateId"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(snapBody, &snap); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("\nsnapshot lastUpdateId = %d\n", snap.LastUpdateID)
	fmt.Printf("%-6s %-14s %-14s %-9s %s\n", "idx", "U (firstId)", "u (lastId)", "u-U+1", "vs snapshot")
	firstApplicable := -1
	var prevU int64
	for i, fr := range frames {
		var d struct {
			U int64 `json:"U"`
			Lu int64 `json:"u"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(fr.Data, &d); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		note := ""
		switch {
		case d.Lu <= snap.LastUpdateID:
			note = "stale, discard"
		case d.U <= snap.LastUpdateID+1 && d.Lu >= snap.LastUpdateID+1:
			note = "FIRST TO APPLY"
			if firstApplicable < 0 {
				firstApplicable = i
			}
		default:
			note = "after the first"
		}
		contig := ""
		if i > 0 {
			if d.U == prevU+1 {
				contig = " contiguous"
			} else {
				contig = fmt.Sprintf(" GAP: U=%d but prev u=%d", d.U, prevU)
			}
		}
		fmt.Printf("%-6d %-14d %-14d %-9d %s%s\n", i, d.U, d.Lu, d.Lu-d.U+1, note, contig)
		prevU = d.Lu
	}
	fmt.Printf("\nwrote %s and %s\n", snapPath, framePath)
}
